name: Kakin Royal Family
description: The sovereign royal family of the Kakin Empire, led by King Nasubi Hui Guo Rou.

name: Hunter Association
description: World Hunter Organization, in charge of the expedition to the Dark Continent and the civil security of the Black Whale.

name: The Zodiacs
description: The twelve highest-ranking leaders of the Hunters Association.

name: Kakin Royal Army
description: Military force of the Empire (2,000 soldiers on board), responsible for martial law and the security of Tiers 1 and 2.

name: Justice Bureau
description: Kakin's Office of Justice, the judicial and investigative authority on board. Handles the voyage's legal proceedings from the Tier 1 Supreme Court and keeps operating after the declaration of special martial law.

name: Phantom Troupe
description: Also known as the Phantom (Spider) Squad. Criminal organization infiltrated Tier 5 to hunt down Hisoka.

name: Xi-Yu Family
description: Mafia family secretly supported by 3rd Prince Zhang Lei. Maintains economic order and controls Tier 4. Boss: Onior Longbao, quartered in the Tier 1 VVIP living quarters; underboss: Hinrigh.

name: Cha-R Family
description: Mafia family under the protection of the 7th Prince Luzurus. Controls Tier 5 and the commodities stored there, warehouses included. Boss: Brocco Li, quartered in the Tier 1 VVIP living quarters; underboss: Ken'i Wang.

name: Heil-Ly Family
description: Mafia family exploited by the 4th Prince Tserriednich. Assigned Tier 3, the uppermost of the three mafia-run decks, but its registered office there is abandoned early for a secret hideout on Tier 2. Led by Morena Prudo, aims to destroy balance through chaos.

name: Faction Benjamin
description: Private military forces (Kakin Royal Guard) loyal to 1st Prince Benjamin.

name: Faction Camilla
description: Intimates and supporters of the 2nd Princess Camilla.

name: Faction Zhang Lei
description: Forces loyal to 3rd Prince Zhang Lei, linked to the Xi-Yu mafia.

name: Faction Tserriednich
description: Supporters of the 4th Prince Tserriednich, linked to the Heil-Ly mafia.

name: Faction Tubeppa
description: Supporters and guards of the 5th Princess Tubeppa.

name: Faction Tyson
description: Guards of the 6th Princess Tyson, devoted to romantic taboos.

name: Faction Luzurus
description: Forces linked to the 7th Prince Luzurus and the Cha-R mafia.

name: Faction Salé-salé
description: Guard manipulated by the Beast of Nen of the 8th Prince Salé-salé.

name: Faction Halkenburg
description: Supporters of the 9th Prince Halkenburg, sharing a collective aura.

name: Faction Kacho
description: Entourage of the 10th Princess Kacho.

name: Faction Fugetsu
description: Entourage of the 11th Princess Fugetsu.

name: Faction Momoze
description: Guards of the 12th Princess Momoze (assassinated).

name: Faction Marayam
description: Defenders of the 13th Prince Marayam (Hunters and guards).

name: Faction Woble
description: Hunters (led by Kurapika) and guards protecting the 14th Princess Woble and Queen Oito.
